title: Residents who answer: the island where every resident thinks
about: The life control (one mind-backed newcomer on the island as shipped) with every resident's mind thought for by the same service: `minds.only` is `all`, so the runner sets no LIVING_ONLY and every person and animal of the island is this service's (docs/SEEDED_LIVES.md). Since 2026-11-11 every person has a mind from the start; there is no instinct-only resident to wake. Residents think with the models file's person route (the `people` mix), the newcomer with the variant's model. Run it with the deepseek-flash variant (fastest good talker) as replicates on fixed world seeds. This is the costliest preset: a full island of minds.
gradient: Social: does the newcomer get food, a bed and a lesson by asking, and does it end up living inside the walls rather than as a forager outside them? Do the residents it met remember it later, from their own perception only?

background.arrived: today, on foot, by the road to Brackenford's gate

needs: world_seeds: replicate k runs with world.overrides.seed = world_seeds[k] (the island seed's own `seed`, 7); the runner's --replicates reuses one world seed today
variants: the default variant for this preset, so a plain run uses deepseek-flash for the subject; residents take the models file's person route unless a variant's models patch assigns them
